name: docs-update
description: Synchronize all documentation surfaces after code changes. Use when the user says "docs-update", "update docs", "sync docs", "update references", "docs are stale", or after any significant code change (CLI commands, schema fields, install methods, new features). This skill catches stale references across 50+ files: marketing site, mkdocs pages, llms.txt, the agent skill, CLI help text, viewer UI, and READMEs. Proactively suggest this after merging features or changing CLI surface.
